messages:
Sean: Heads up @Marta @Ian — Acme needs split billing for the POC -> contract conversion. Requirements from their finance: split invoice (60/40), two PO numbers, net30, DocuSign to two signers, and KMS mention in the DPA. Can procurement/legal advise on whether to do 1 order form referencing both POs or two separate order forms? Also they want pricing held for 90 days after PO issuance for conversion.

Marta: Who are the billing contacts + tax IDs? Finance usually prefers one order form per legal entity. Splitting on a single invoice is doable but we need their billing address and cost center codes. If you paste the PO numbers I can start routing. :thinking:

Sean: PO numbers below + contacts. Copying counsel for visibility.
```
PO1: 880-ACME-PO1 — $48,000 (60%)
PO2: 880-ACME-PO2 — $32,000 (40%)
Legal signer: alice@acme.com
Finance signer: bob.finance@acme.com
Legal counsel: jessica.counsel@acme.com
Entity: Acme Inc (EIN 12-3456789)
Billing address: 123 Industrial Ave, Suite 400, Palo Alto, CA 94000
Cost centers: CC-TR-01 (60%), CC-TR-02 (40%)
Invoice terms: Net30
```

Nina: Quick note on pricing: we can hold the quoted pricing for 90 days from PO issuance if they convert to a committed annual plan. I'll add that clause into the draft order form. Also confirm SLA tier — they asked for Gold for Dedicated.

Ian: @Sean please send the redlines PDF to me. High-level: split billing is fine but the DPA needs explicit KMS language and clearer subprocessor constraints if they plan any on-prem data handling. We have a KMS addendum template — if they want BYOK we need key ownership language. For routing, we prefer a single order form that references both PO numbers to avoid double contract entries; if the customer insists on two separate order forms, legal will add cross-reference clauses which takes extra review time.

Marta: Finance confirmed they accept split invoice with both PO numbers on one invoice line set, provided each line shows the cost center code. They also need invoices to be addressed to bob.finance@acme.com and include the EIN. Estimated internal approval 2-3 business days once legal signs off on routing.

Sean: Attaching redlines link and a sample invoice for accounting: https://files.internal/acme/redlines-v1.pdf (redlines). Also note the conversion credit: 10% credit back on committed annual plan if converted within 90 days of PO. @Nina will add exact language.

Nina: Confirmed. Draft clause I'll add to order form: "Pricing hold: Quoted rates will be held for 90 days from PO issuance for the purpose of conversion to a committed annual agreement. If executed within that window, customer receives a one-time credit equal to 10% of the first-year committed spend." Also adding SLA Gold reference and a toggle for Dedicated capacity in the order form.

Ian: I've started a legal doc with the DPA KMS addendum and flagged these redlines: explicit BYOK option, key ownership section, and subprocessor carve-outs for on-prem telemetry. If they accept Redwood-managed KMS with BYOK later, we can proceed faster.

docu-sign-bot: docu-sign-bot created envelope `0x8a7f3c` and sent to alice@acme.com, bob.finance@acme.com — status: sent.

Marta: I'll route the draft invoice and request signed authority for split payment routing. I'll note finance needs the AO/Approver name on the invoice for their AP system.

Sean: Great — I'll wait for legal ack on the redlines and for the signed envelope. After legal confirms KMS language, I'll publish the single order form that references both POs and include the pricing hold + KMS addendum. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:

Ian: ack, will review redlines today and loop counsel if they push non-standard subprocessor terms.

Marta: thanks, ping me if finance asks for any additional supporting docs.

Sean: FYI customer counsel (jessica.counsel@acme.com) asked if we can include a tax exemption certificate if they provide one — flagged it to finance.

Nina: noted, will add a placeholder line to order form for tax exemption docs.

Sean: moving to action items: 1) Ian to confirm DPA + KMS addendum language; 2) Nina to insert pricing hold + SLA; 3) Marta to route to Acme finance once envelope signed; 4) Sean to send final order form.

Marta: I'll start the finance route once docu-sign shows completed.

docu-sign-bot: envelope `0x8a7f3c` status updated: signed by alice@acme.com (2024-11-06T14:12:03Z). Waiting on bob.finance@acme.com.

Sean: thanks — keeping thread open for final signer confirmation and invoice routing.

Marta: received. once bob signs i'll push to AP.
